_about: Round 152: the pull -- almost-there teasers, a sitting readout, omens in the deep, bark lines from the beasts and people at your side, petting and feeding, streak titles. Nothing here is paid or exclusive. (scripts/systems/Pull.gd)

cache.name: A glint in the dark
cache.found: A traveller's cache, forgotten and still sealed.

spirit.name: A wandering spirit
spirit.found: A spirit of the deep brushes past you, and what it carries settles in you.

sage.name: A hermit's afterglow
sage.found: Where a hermit once sat, understanding lingers like warmth in a stone.

tracker: sniffs the air and tugs you toward something.
freezes, nose up: there was something here.
forager: paws at a root, proud of itself.
digger: scrabbles at the ground, delighted by the dirt.
hunter: watches the shadows with bright, patient eyes.
licks its lips at the smell of game.
healer: presses close, warm against your side.
breathes slow and even, steadying you.
guardian: plants its feet and faces the dark.
bumps your leg: stay behind it.
striker: bristles, eager for the next fight.
lantern: glows a little brighter for you.
scholar: tilts its head at the old walls, thinking.
blinks slowly, as if it has understood something.
courier: circles you, restless to be moving.
darts ahead and waits, tail high.
charmer: leans on you the way a friend does.
lucky: trots with its head high, sure the day is good.
nudges your pocket and looks innocent.
warden: stands steady, a calm weight at your side.
ember: sparks, and looks thrilled with the sparks.
hoarder: guards a pebble it thinks is treasure.
brewer: sniffs a leaf and sneezes happily.
mystic: hums at nothing, and the air hums back.
gazes at the dark as if it were a window.
sentinel: keeps its eyes on your back.
marksman: tracks something far off with unblinking eyes.

floor: Stay close. I'll take the left.
boss: That's a big one. I'm with you.

floor: I smell water, and something worse.
boss: Never seen one that big go down that easy.
clear: That's a floor I'd cross twice.

floor: Lead the way, I'll make the noise.
